item.title: Data Preprocessing for Kaggle Dataset
item.description:
• Preprocessed a Kaggle dataset using a variety of data cleaning and feature engineering techniques, including dropping NaN values, one-hot encoding, and median imputation.
  • Enhanced key features from Name and Cabin variables, increasing SVM accuracy by 7.3% and improving overall model performance.

item.title: Web scraping: Higher Education Funding Offers
item.description:
• Addressed funding challenges for international students in US by developing a comprehensive web scraping pipeline.
  • Used requests, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, and pandas to extract data on professors from the CSRankings website who are seeking new students.

item.title: NYC Air Quality Data Analysis
item.description:
• Analyzed NYC air quality data focusing on pollutants like Nitrogen dioxide, Sulfur dioxide, Ozone, and PM2.5.
  • Demonstrated a positive trend in air quality improvement over the past decade, with significant reductions in Nitrogen dioxide and PM2.5 emissions.
